method_change_relative_to_v2: none; v3 changes only confirmation provenance and seed sampling after discovering that the four v1 seeds had already been executed

interaction_measurement.k4_retention: four scalar witness projections per complete chronology; no K4 model-space endpoint or interaction tensors retained
interaction_measurement.target_active_lift_replay: bitwise tensor SHA256 equality to the independently replayed target endpoint

witness_bank.construction: for each candidate final stage j, form the six degree-three full-history predictions ending in j, project the target onto their convex hull, and normalize target-minus-projection to obtain u_j
witness_bank.freeze_rule: all four witnesses for a target must be fully constructed and unit-norm checked using only K3 information plus the given target endpoint before the first K4 candidate active-lift output

certificate.hierarchy: nonnegative K-local order marginals with simplex and adjacent-level marginal consistency
certificate.pairwise_decision_rule: for each unordered stage pair {i,j}, solve both precedence classes i<j and j<i without access to the true chronology label
certificate.euclidean_soundness: because every u_j is unit norm, max_j absolute witness projection is no larger than Euclidean residual norm
certificate.solver: scipy.optimize.linprog highs proposes primal and dual values; the reported bound clips and L1-normalizes inequality duals, recomputes reduced costs, applies one simplex-minimum correction per local subset, and subtracts a floating-point guard
certificate.class_exclusion_rule: an orientation class is certified impossible only if its proof-safe Euclidean distance lower bound exceeds the elimination guard
certificate.pair_inference_rule: exactly one excluded class implies the opposite orientation; neither excluded implies ambiguity; both excluded is invalid
certificate.full_chronology_rule: full chronology is returned only if all six pair orientations are inferred and form one transitive total order
certificate.terminal_exactness_check: at K=N=4 each orientation-class local-order LP primal must match an independent complete-permutation convex-hull witness-space LP within 1e-8
certificate.label_use_rule: the generating history may be used only after pair decisions are fixed, for evaluation

theory_scope.terminal_exactness: at K=N=4 the hierarchy contains the full permutation simplex and there is no omitted interaction tail
theory_scope.fixed_k_scaling: coordinate count sum_{r<=K} P(N,r) is polynomial in N for fixed K; pairwise property decisions are O(N^2)
theory_scope.exactness_below_terminal_level: for K<N, promotion to an exact true-endpoint claim requires an explicit omitted-interaction bound or increasing K
theory_scope.information_barrier: without additional regularity assumptions, unseen K+1 interactions cannot be universally bounded from degree-K observations alone

fresh_confirmation_change_policy: after this v3 lock, do not change witness construction, interaction degree, two-sided pairwise decision rule, LP formulation or correction, thresholds, target histories, outcome tiers, or validity rules based on fresh confirmation outputs
